Activation.description:
What it costs to use a mode. ``cost`` is system vocabulary
(D&D: action, bonus_action, reaction, minute, hour; PF2e: actions, free).
Activation.title: Activation

AreaOption.description: One shape the caster may pick; ``Areas.options`` lists the alternatives.
AreaOption.title: AreaOption

CastChoice.description: A pick the caster makes (damage type, creature variant, shape, ...).
CastChoice.title: CastChoice

Chain.description: The spell jumps to more targets (Chain Lightning, 2024 Chromatic Orb).
Chain.title: Chain

ConditionEnd.description: One way a condition ends; any entry in ``Applies.ends`` ends it.
ConditionEnd.title: ConditionEnd

DamagePart.description: One damage roll. ``id`` is stable so scaling patches can target it.
DamagePart.title: DamagePart

Distribution.description: Units split across targets (Magic Missile darts, Eldritch Blast beams).
Distribution.title: Distribution

Drift.description: The area moves by itself (Cloudkill: 10 feet away from you each turn).
Drift.title: Drift

FromDamage.description:
Healing equal to damage the mode's rolls before it dealt, after resistances
(Vampiric Touch: half the Necrotic damage; Life Transference: twice what you take).
FromDamage.title: FromDamage

Gap.description:
Something the text mentions that the block lacks. The VTT treats the
spell as partly manual until the gap is filled or ignored in
``data/manual/spells/vtt.json``.
Gap.title: Gap

Light.description:
Light (or darkness) an area makes, or that a creature or object sheds (``Applies.light``).
On an area the radii are measured from its edge; on a creature or object, from its space.
Light.title: Light

Material.description: A barrier the effect can't pass ("1 foot of stone", "a thin sheet of lead").
Material.title: Material

Mode.description: One way the spell acts: the cast, or a later action (Flaming Sphere's ram).
Mode.title: Mode

Movable.description: The caster can move it (Moonbeam, Flaming Sphere); the action is a mode.
Movable.title: Movable

Op.description: One patch. ``part`` names a stable id (a damage part, a target option).
Op.title: Op

Participants.description: Extra casters who join and pay (2024 Circle spells, PF2e rituals).
Participants.title: Participants

Pool.description: An HP pool spent from the lowest current HP up (2014 Sleep, Color Spray).
Pool.title: Pool

Roll.description: One roll in a mode. ``check`` is the target checking against your DC.
Roll.title: Roll

ScalingRule.description:
``every`` steps from ``from``, or ``steps`` for uneven tables. ``by`` is the
variable it reads: __CAST_LEVEL (upcast, PF2e heighten), __CASTER_CHARACTER_LEVEL
(cantrips), __CASTER_CLASS_LEVEL, or __PARTICIPANT_COUNT.
ScalingRule.title: ScalingRule

ScalingStep.description: One row of an ``at`` table: Fire Bolt at 5 → 2d10.
ScalingStep.title: ScalingStep

Size.description: One dimension: "20-foot radius", "up to 60 feet long", "5 to 100 feet".
Size.title: Size

SummonChange.description: A change to the stat block: Find Familiar's type becomes Celestial, Fey, or Fiend.
SummonChange.title: SummonChange

SummonOption.description: One way to fill the summon; the caster picks one option.
SummonOption.title: SummonOption

SummonQuery.description: Any monster that matches. An empty list matches anything.
SummonQuery.title: SummonQuery

Trigger.description:
An ongoing trigger: a zone (4.3) or a ward on a creature (hit_by_melee).
Several events share one roll and one limit ("enters the Emanation or ends
its turn there ... only once per turn").
Trigger.title: Trigger

UnresolvedText.description: Rule text the engine doesn't run; the table sees it as a note.
UnresolvedText.title: UnresolvedText

VarAmount.title: VarAmount

VarMap.description:
A value picked by a variable: ``map[var value]``. Spirit Guardians:
``{var: __CASTER_ALIGNMENT_SIMPLE, map: {good: radiant, neutral: radiant, evil: necrotic}}``.
VarMap.title: VarMap

Variant.description:
Another way to cast the same spell. Picking it applies ``patch`` to the base
and, if ``modes`` is set, replaces the base modes. Use a variant when the pick
changes what the spell does (Command's commands, Heal's action counts, Circle
casting); use a CastChoice when the pick only fills in a value (a damage type).
Variant.title: Variant

WhileActive.description: An effect that lasts only while the condition does ("While Charmed, ...").
WhileActive.title: WhileActive

description:
Everything the VTT needs to resolve a spell, beside the catalog fields
(``is_ritual`` and the rest stay on the spell itself).
title: VttSpellFields
